title: Global Comparison - 2 Topologies x 3 Communication Modes
description: All 6 configs run on the same codebase (v2) with improved code context retrieval. 50 SWE-bench Lite issues (20 easy, 20 medium, 10 hard).
codebase_version: v2 (with smart code context retrieval, function region extraction, grep fallback)

resolve_rate_matrix.description: Resolve rate (%) for each topology x communication combination

avg_tokens_matrix.description: Average tokens per issue for each topology x communication combination

avg_latency_matrix.description: Average latency (seconds) per issue for each topology x communication combination

blackboard_effect_cross_topology.description: Blackboard vs Message-Passing improvement by topology
blackboard_effect_cross_topology.conclusion: Blackboard advantage is consistent and even STRONGER in Debate (+26pp) than Sequential (+20pp). This validates that structured shared state benefits are topology-independent.

hybrid_effect_cross_topology.description: Hybrid vs Message-Passing improvement by topology
hybrid_effect_cross_topology.conclusion: Hybrid improvement is also consistent across topologies (+22pp Sequential, +26pp Debate).

hybrid_vs_blackboard_cross_topology.description: Does adding NL context (Hybrid) help beyond pure Blackboard?
hybrid_vs_blackboard_cross_topology.conclusion: Hybrid provides marginal benefit in Sequential (+2pp) but zero benefit in Debate (0pp). In Debate, the multi-perspective competition already compensates for NL context value.

topology_effect_by_comm_mode.description: Debate vs Sequential improvement by communication mode

Blackboard.interpretation: Debate + BB is the strongest combination: BB structured state + multi-perspective competition

Hybrid.interpretation: Similar to BB; Hybrid's NL context adds little when Debate already provides multiple perspectives

token_efficiency.description: Tokens per resolved issue (lower is more efficient)

key_findings: 1. BEST CONFIG: Debate + Blackboard achieves 50.0% resolve rate (25/50), the highest across all 6 configs
2. BLACKBOARD EFFECT IS TOPOLOGY-INDEPENDENT: +20pp in Sequential, +26pp in Debate — consistent and strong
3. DEBATE AMPLIFIES BLACKBOARD: Debate + BB gains +18pp over Seq + BB, more than MP's +12pp gain from Debate
4. HYBRID = BLACKBOARD IN DEBATE: No additional benefit from NL context when multi-perspective debate already provides diversity
5. DEBATE HELPS ALL MODES: +12pp for MP, +18pp for BB, +16pp for Hybrid — multi-perspective competition is universally beneficial
6. TOKEN COST TRADEOFF: Debate uses ~60% more tokens than Sequential, but achieves significantly higher resolve rates
7. SEQUENTIAL BB IS MOST EFFICIENT: 72,932 tokens/resolve — best cost-effectiveness ratio
8. HARD ISSUES REMAIN HARD: 0-20% resolve rate for hard issues across all configs — fundamental capability limitation
9. MEDIUM DIFFICULTY BENEFITS MOST: Debate + BB/Hybrid achieve 60% on medium issues (vs 20-40% for Sequential)
